rows.note: Use this for the male-person meaning, rather than for a companion or a generic individual.

example.jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 jan4 gei2 jau5 jing4 wo3

rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose word for a companion or comrade.

example.english: I have lunch with this fellow all the time.
example.traditional: 我同呢個朋友成日一齊食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 ni1 go3 pang4 jau5 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for the generic individual meaning when gender is irrelevant.

example.english: This fellow is very careful at work.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jan4 zou6 je5 hou2 sai3 sam1

rows.meaning: person of the same kind; colleague
rows.note: Use this for someone of the same type or group, rather than specifically a work colleague.

example.english: He's a fellow antique enthusiast; we both like studying antiques.
example.traditional: 佢同我係同類，都鍾意研究古董。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tung4 ngo5 hai6 tung4 leoi6 dou1 zung1 ji3 jin4 gau3 gu2 dung2
